title: Document how to have preselected menu items without showing the menu
body:
Usecase: I want to display a page that will only search for shirts, without having the actual product menu selection being shown.

Solution:

```js
const VirtualRefinementList = RefinementList.connect(() => null);
<InstantSearch>
  <VirtualRefinementList defaultSelectedItems={['shirt']} />
</InstantSearch>
```

The naming is not good, but the feature it provides is really awesome. For the first time we are able to indicates we want predefined values without having the user to do a mental mapping between SearchParameters and UI state. It's all about UI here. Even when it's invisible for the user.
